result.summary: Literature review for seed 806, round 1 (B group, 文献员 role). Read analysis.md's four literature questions targeting core A (day_cov(Vwap,Ret)), its proxy-risk decomposition, the LimitWidth component, and reward stability-over-time. Searched only pre-2023-08-08 sources via WebSearch/WebFetch, verifying exact dates for borderline-2023 papers via PMC and Crossref API. Wrote operator-language translations of literature treatments (half-hour/overnight-intraday slicing, realized semivariance sign-splitting, industry-relative standardization, DiD around the 2020-08-24 ChiNext price-limit widening, momentum-managed z-score timing, factor half-life) with per-topic "not found / date uncertain" caveats, plus a 14-entry source list with title/authors/year-month/venue/link/verified flag. 13 of 14 sources were directly verified (multiple independent corroborating pages or direct WebFetch of primary metadata); one (Flint & Vermaak SSRN working paper) is marked verified:false because the SSRN page returned HTTP 403 and its first-posting date could not be personally confirmed, flagged for the 检查 stage to re-check. No code/PLAN changes, no other seeds' or groups' files read, no server run, no commits made.
